siliconflow-ocr 1.0.0

- Initial release of the SiliconFlow OCR skill, leveraging the SiliconFlow API for high-accuracy text extraction from images and PDFs.
- Uses PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 by default for document OCR (OmniDocBench SOTA), with faster speed and improved table/formula extraction over Qwen3-VL.
- Supports both local image/PDF paths and URLs, with single-page and concurrent multi-page processing capabilities.
- Built-in coordinate token cleaning and robust error handling (timeouts, proxy, and auth errors).
- Environment-specific key injection via OpenClaw and enforced use of requests plus gateway proxy for API calls.
- Includes guidance for optimal model selection and PDF page rendering (using pymupdf) for best results.
